comments.text: From audit prompt gist: 'Archive extraction — :erl_tar, :zip, any unpack where entry names become filesystem paths (zip-slip).' The extractor should flag :erl_tar.extract/2, :zip.extract/2, and :zip.unzip/2 when the destination path or entry names could be tainted. Zip-slip allows writing outside the target directory via ../ in archive entry names. Severity: High.

title: Elixir: detect zip-slip via :erl_tar and :zip archive extraction with tainted entry names
